author: sinofstrife
name: NoPings
short: Suppresses reply pings globally or for specific users.
description: Prevents the bot from using ping replies globally across the server or for specifically targeted users.
install_msg: Thanks for installing NoPings! Use `[p]nopings toggle` to silence bot reply pings server-wide, or `[p]nopings add @user` to add specific members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord User IDs on a per-guild basis to maintain a no-ping reply list.
